supporter.purpose:
These cards represent the groups of major influence in District Noir. Each group of SUPPORTERS has a set number of members, and you will need to get the majority of them to gain their victory points and win the game.

This one is worth {points, plural, one{# point} other{# points}} to the player having the most copies.
count.in.deck: It appears {number} times in the deck.
betrayal.purpose:
These cards represent the treacheries that mark your path to control of the District Noir.
It's up to you to do everything you can to avoid them!

It will cost you {points, plural, one{# point} other{# points}} if in your possession at the end of the game.
alliance.purpose:
These cards represent the deals that mark your path to control of the District Noir.
It's up to you to get them!

It will earn you {points, plural, one{# point} other{# points}} if in your possession at the end of the game.
camp.token: This token shows the two Factions that can be played. This token is used to determine which player goes first at the start of each round.
city.purpose:
There are 3 strategic locations in the CITY: the docks, the police station and the city hall.

At any moment, if you manage to obtain these 3 cards, you immediately win the game!
deck.size: There {number, plural, one{is # card} other {are # cards}} left in the deck.
tuto.goal:
<italic>Hoboken, New Jersey - 1954</italic>
At the head of the largest criminal organizations, powerful leaders vie for territory and support, trying to grow their influence by any means necessary.
tuto.actions:
On your turn, you have 2 possible actions:
• <bold>play a card</bold> from your hand at the end of the line.
• <bold>take the last 5 cards</bold> of the line.
tuto.play.1: Let's start by playing this card from your hand, in the line.
tuto.opponent.played.1: Your opponent has placed this card in the line.
tuto.take:
It's your turn.
You could take this line, even if there are only 4 cards. However, you're only allowed to do this once per round.
tuto.play.2: Play this card in the line instead.
tuto.opponent.played.2:
Your opponent has played.
Now choose to take the last 5 cards in the row, by clicking on the button in the header.
tuto.supporter:
These cards are Supporters.
At the end of the game, For each of the different groups of <bold>Supporters</bold>, the player who has <bold>the majority</bold> of those cards scores victory points equal to the number shown on that <bold>Support</bold> type (5, 6, 7 or 8 points).
tuto.alliance: These cards are Alliances. They are worth the number of points indicated.
tuto.betrayal: These cards are betrayals. They cause you to lose the number of points indicated.
tuto.cities:
Finally, there are 3 city cards in the game (the police station, the docks and the city hall).
If you get these 3 cards, you immediately win the game!
Otherwise, they don't score any points at the end of the game.
tuto.round:
Each round, you must play your 5 cards, and take the last 5 cards in the row once.
Players then draw 5 cards again, and the first player changes.
tuto.end:
When there are no more cards in the deck, the game is over, and the player with the most points wins.
Good luck!
